entries.description: 3D photorealistic Earth WebGPU simulation — atmospheric scattering, dynamic lighting, real-time post-processing and interactive controls. Localized in all 16 site languages.

three.js cosmic-navigation experiment — simulated galaxy of catalogued stars plus authored bodies (solar system, exoplanets, deep-sky objects) with localized dossiers. Bodies deep-link via /star-field-experiment/<body-id>.

Browsable documentation portal for luiskr.com — architecture guides, quality reports, per-file test coverage and the annotated source tree. Every published file is a crawlable /docs/<root>/<path> route with JSON-LD and microdata.

Every animation on luiskr.com, described — element, motion, trigger, technology and purpose. Static readable markup in all 16 site languages; the same records drive the runtime aria-label/longdesc accessibility surface.

Catalog of the site's full-content replica surface: every public route as Markdown and JSON in all 16 languages (~19k routes × 2 formats). Canonical mirror tree under /llm/<locale>/<route>.{md,json}; sibling convention appends .md/.json to any page URL. Policy: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes.
